notable_absence.finding: This overview page has no outbound Markdown links at all, despite introducing bucket types, compression, TTL, memory quotas and ejection - every one of which is elaborated on a sibling page in this same directory (buckets.md, compression.md, memory.md). It closes with 'The pages in this section provide detailed descriptions of buckets, memory, and storage' but never links to any of them by name; the section's navigation is presumably carried entirely by the docs site's left-nav rather than in-page links, which means an LLM or agent given only this page's Markdown text has no way to discover buckets.md, memory.md, storage-engines.md, storage-settings.md, compression.md or vbuckets.md exist.
